podcast.body: Jim Stafford built a career as a talented musician and performer specializing in novelty songs. He is known for playing multiple instruments and writing many of his songs. "Jim Stafford, a very talented musician and performer who made a career out of novelty songs."

podcast.title: Inspiration from Edgar Allan Poe
podcast.body: One of Stafford's inspirations was Edgar Allan Poe, particularly for the imagery Poe used in his literature, which Stafford attempted to replicate in his songs. "One of his inspirations is Edgar Alan Poe because of the imagery that Poe uses in his literature Stafford tried to replicate that in his songs."

podcast.title: Vocal Insecurities
podcast.body: He recorded many of his novelty songs by "half singing, half talking" due to personal insecurities about his voice, despite possessing a clearly good voice. "He recorded variety songs because of his own insecurities about his voice so in a lot of his songs he kind of half sings, half talks."
